statements.t: “Our Phase 3 PTCL and Phase 2 atopic dermatitis clinical trials are on track and there has been strong interest in our new hidradenitis suppurativa trial.

We believe soquelitinib has the potential to be effective in both types of asthma patients based on its mechanism of action affecting Th2, Th17 and T regulatory cells, which we will be closely analyzing in our hidradenitis suppurativa trial.
The Company believes the inhibition of specific molecular targets in T cells may be of therapeutic benefit for patients with autoimmune and allergic diseases and in cancers, including solid tumors.
